name: Parastremmatic Dysplasia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Parastremmatic Dysplasia

criteria.description: Severe generalized skeletal dysplasia with marked bowing and deformities of long bones
Characteristic radiographic appearance of irregular metaphyseal flaring and widened growth plates
Clinical presentation of disproportionate short-limbed dwarfism
Identification of mutations in the DDR2 gene
Normal cognitive development despite severe skeletal abnormalities

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria (severe skeletal dysplasia, characteristic radiographic features, and short-limbed dwarfism) with or without genetic confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for DDR2 mutations can confirm diagnosis but is not mandatory if clinical and radiological features are definitive.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe bowing and deformity of long bones
Irregular metaphyseal flaring with widened growth plates on radiographs
searchTerms: irregular widening of bone growth areas
short limbs with normal torso size

common.symptomName: Thoracic cage deformity leading to restrictive lung disease
searchTerms: abnormal rib cage shape causing lung problems

common.symptomName: Delayed motor milestones due to skeletal abnormalities
searchTerms: slow motor skill development due to bone problems
late crawling or walking from skeletal issues

common.symptomName: Short stature with normal head size
searchTerms: short height with normal head size
small stature but normal head circumference

occasional.symptomName: Spinal deformities including scoliosis and kyphosis
Respiratory infections secondary to restrictive lung disease
searchTerms: lung infections due to restricted breathing
frequent respiratory infections from lung problems
breathing-related infections caused by chest deformities

rare.symptomName: Cor pulmonale due to chronic respiratory compromise
searchTerms: right heart failure from lung disease
heart strain due to lung problems

rare.symptomName: Neurological deficits from spinal cord compression
searchTerms: weakness due to spinal cord squeezing
loss of sensation from spinal compression

imaging: Radiographs showing irregular metaphyseal flaring and widened growth plates
Severe bowing and deformities of long bones
Spinal deformities including scoliosis and kyphosis
genetic: Mutations in DDR2 gene identified by molecular genetic testing
other: Normal cognitive development despite severe skeletal abnormalities

distinguishingFeatures: Less severe bowing of long bones

redFlags: Severe respiratory compromise due to thoracic cage deformity
Progressive spinal deformities causing neurological deficits
Failure to thrive due to skeletal abnormalities
references: Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Parastremmatic dysplasia. In: GeneReviews® [Internet]. University of Washington, Seattle; 2020.
